feature: Native goal continuation through the Copilot Messages/Responses adapter

observed_failure.phase: automatic goal continuation after a completed turn

cause: A named native context item was translated to an Anthropic tool_result without its required tool_use_id.
fix: Keep the original native item unchanged; port plaintext named contextual outputs to explicitly labelled untrusted user context.
Apply the adaptation before SDK inference for Responses and Messages.
Preserve real tool-call IDs and put real Anthropic tool-result blocks before other context in their user message.
Reject missing context identities and protected encrypted context before forwarding; diagnostics contain only model and item count.
evidence_note: The old provider response body was intentionally not retained. Diagnosis uses the exact native context record, the required provider schema, and successful fresh Opus continuations after adapting it.
